title: Chapter 142: Inspecting The Troops On The Battlefield
content:
Chapter 142: Inspecting The Troops On The Battlefield

More than 200,000 Zerg troops entered the designated defense area of the Zerg underground territory in advance and hid underground.

The entire Zerg underground territory looked very quiet, and only in some areas could the busy figures of worker bees be seen.

Looking up, there were defensive buildings everywhere. There were anti-aircraft towers in the middle of multiple defensive spikes. Small formations formed large formations, and large formations were wrapped in small formations, which defended the Zerg territory tightly.

After summarizing the combat experience of two nights, the distribution of these defensive buildings is now more reasonable.

Rows of Zerg one-star nests, each nest has thirty larvae waiting to hatch. As long as the battle starts and resources are deposited, they will instantly hatch into Zerg combat arms and rush to the battlefield.

The sun sets, night falls, and the whole world is once again shrouded in a strange shadow.

Wu Qing and the entire Zerg are quietly waiting, waiting for the mysterious enemy to appear, waiting for the unknown underground world race to attack.

Unfortunately, there are many things in this world that are often beyond people's expectations.

The mysterious enemy that attacked the Zerg underground territory for two consecutive nights seemed to have stopped tonight. Wu Qing and the Zerg waited for half the night, but there was no movement.

A large number of Zerg hosts kept patrolling the entire territory, and the one-star hosts kept scanning and detecting in the vulnerable areas, searching for those strange figures.

Everything was in vain, and nothing was detected.

But the Zerg cannot relax their vigilance. Perhaps this is another trick played by the mysterious enemy, who wants to catch them off guard.

This time Wu Qing was indeed too worried. Until the sun rose, the strangeness disappeared, and the Zerg's underground territory was not attacked at all.

Wu Qing felt a little disappointed because he didn't wait for the attack of the mysterious enemy.

"I wasted a night and gained nothing!"

The Zerg territory was attacked. As long as it was successfully defended, the gains would be huge. If the mysterious enemy didn't come, the Zerg would have missed a good opportunity for development.

"Yes, such a good thing can't be encountered every day!"

Wu Qing took his consciousness back to his body and entered a deep sleep state. He needed to recover his spirit.

The Queen of Insects controlled Wu Qing's insect clone and mobilized all the more than 200,000 insect troops that were prepared to guard the territory last night, and began to march towards the scheduled assembly point.

There is another big battle to be fought during the day today!

As soon as the insect army left the insect territory, Wu Cong had already led the army of Da Xia to wait.

The army of Da Xia was all dressed in black armor, with swords hanging on their waists, and they were lightly dressed, carrying only drinking water and dry food with them.

They all walked. Da Xia had some captured lizard mounts, but they all looked down on them and would rather be infantry than ride lizards.

Wu Qing's insect clone was now controlled by the Queen of Insects. He met Wu Cong and didn't say much.

Wu Cong led the army of Da Xia to follow the insect army to the assembly point. He looked at the endless insect army in front and behind, and his thoughts were full of thoughts.

They were rescued by the Zerg, but they didn't expect that the Zerg's strength was so unfathomable, more mysterious than many of the great tribes he had seen.

Such a powerful race only had a small Daxia territory, without even a decent city.

Lord Wu Qing was also mysterious. With his many years of experience in judging people, he couldn't tell whether the lord was real or fake.

But he could see some of Wu Qing's general character, and working under such a lord would not be a loss.

Wu Cong was relieved to find such a destination for his men. He had experienced a life-and-death struggle and endured countless hardships. He also let go of many things.

The Zerg army marched very fast, and it didn't take long for them to reach the designated gathering place.

The Zerg's scout dogs set out at dawn and brought the entire area where the alliance was located into the control of the Zerg.

The lords of several alliance territories closest to the gathering place had already arrived with their troops.

Through the information collected by the scout dogs, it can be seen that all alliance territories have sent troops.

The lords who can become lords and maintain independence under the oppression of the Tengu clan are not fools. If they still don't understand Wu Qing's obvious gift of benefits, they are not worthy of being the lords.

It is unlikely that they can conquer the cities of the evil god camp by relying on the armies of their alliance territories. The main force still depends on the Zerg. If they are unlucky and are really used as cannon fodder, they can only accept it.

But this opportunity cannot be missed, and they must fight.

There are more than a dozen territories in the alliance that have sent more than 10,000 troops, among which the five major territories have the largest number of troops, which can be said to be all the troops.

After all the armies of the alliance territories arrived and lined up in an orderly manner, the Queen of Insects woke up Wu Qing.

Wu Qing's consciousness entered the Zerg clone. He stood on a high place and saw an army that could not be seen at a glance.

According to the Queen of Insects' statistics, the total strength of the Zerg army and the armies of the alliance territories is close to 500,000, which is more than expected.

There were tens of thousands of people, and it was boundless. One could imagine what a spectacular scene it would be if nearly half a million troops gathered together!

Wu Qing was used to it. He had experienced many large-scale wars, and the troops in front of him were nothing.

But most of the lords of the alliance and the soldiers in their armies saw such a grand scene for the first time, and they were all excited.

Especially seeing the terrifying number of the Zerg army made them feel at ease.

Most people present had only heard of the power of the Zerg. Many had never even seen the appearance of the Zerg, let alone seen the Zerg fighting.

The first time they saw the Zerg was in such an occasion, which left a very deep impression on them.

Emotions are also a kind of energy. The emotions directed at Wu Qing and the Zerg can bring the system a harvest of Qi resources. Before the war started, the system's Qi resources began to rise rapidly.

Wu Qing glanced at the whole venue and did not speak. In such an open venue and with so many people, even if he shouted suddenly, people in far places might not be able to hear him.

Wu Qing's current strength could not make his voice spread throughout the army. He could use the spiritual power of the host and the queen of the worm to do so, but it was not necessary.

Wu Qing asked someone to invite the lord of the alliance over.

"Everyone, I won't be polite to you on the battlefield!"

"Meng will be in charge of commanding the alliance's army, and Hu Wei will assist!"

"All lords, lead your troops and obey Meng's command!"

"On the battlefield, military law will be enforced! Everyone must obey orders!"

"Otherwise, military law will be ruthless!"

Wu Qing's temperament changed drastically in this situation. He could not help but show the momentum he had cultivated from commanding countless wars in the real world and the virtual world.

All lords, including Meng, could not think of disobeying orders under the pressure of Wu Qing's momentum.
